usage.title: Credits & usage
usage.note: Credits are free during the beta. Paid top-ups are not available yet.
usage.limitsHelp: Free services rarely publish exact limits. Aurevid counts what you use and learns from limit errors, so these numbers get more accurate over time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.keysHelp: Keys are encrypted on our server and never shown again, not even to you. Leave empty to use the shared free tier where available.
settings.exportHelp: A JSON file with your account, prompts and credit history.
settings.deleteHelp: Deletes your account, prompts, images and keys permanently.
settings.steps_cloudflare: Free: 1) Sign up at Cloudflare. 2) My Profile → API Tokens → Create Token → template “Workers AI”. 3) Paste the token here, plus your Account ID (shown on the dashboard home).
settings.steps_fal: Paid (billed to you by fal.ai): 1) Sign in at fal.ai. 2) Dashboard → Keys → Add key. 3) Add a payment method in fal.ai billing. 4) Paste the key here.

terms.title: Terms of Use & Acceptable Use
terms.updated: Draft, last updated 17 November 2026. Not legal advice; review with a lawyer before launch.
terms.s1: You are responsible for the prompts you write, the files you upload and how you use the results. Only upload material you have the right to use.
terms.s2: Content that infringes copyright, trademarks or other rights; deceptive content such as impersonation, fake documents or misleading deepfakes of real people; sexual content; any content that sexualises or endangers minors; content promoting violence, hate or illegal activity; attempts to break, overload or abuse the service.
terms.s3: We filter prompts automatically, review reports, and may remove content or suspend accounts that break these rules. Content involving the abuse of minors is reported to the relevant authorities.
terms.s4: Images are generated by third-party model providers. Your prompt is sent to the provider you choose. Each model has its own licence; check the model's commercial-use label before using results commercially.
terms.s5: We store only what we need to run the service: your email, a password hash, your prompts, images and credit history. You can download or permanently delete your data from Settings.
terms.s6: The service is provided as is during the beta, without guarantees of availability or fitness for a particular purpose.
